grammar.numbers: app widget card on the phone screen: the big number counting up beside a gold progress ring filling (a rate on a 10 % scale); a number that lands while the screen is taken floats as a small white chip above the phone
grammar.comparisons: a page pushed onto the app: two white cards side by side with a navy VS badge, each value with a bar sized against the other, the question as a gold banner
grammar.steps: a checklist page pushed onto the app: each item slides up when said, its round box is tapped (ripple) and ticked gold, a progress bar and n/N count fill
grammar.eligibility: classic verdict cue ✓/✗ (MotionTrack), the phone dims under it
grammar.change: classic change cue (MotionTrack), the phone dims under it
grammar.trend: classic line graph panel (MotionTrack), the phone dims under it
grammar.lenders: app list row sliding in with the logo on its white tile under a neutral ĐANG NHẮC TỚI label
grammar.captionPosition: frosted navy bar under the phone (over its faded lower edge), English line in a smaller bar on SAFE.bottom

skinAxes.cover: title large over the gradient, logo tile top-left, the phone rising from below with the subtitle as a push notification
skinAxes.captions: white words on a frosted navy bar, keywords and numbers gold, the spoken word underlined gold
skinAxes.framing: pure motion graphics: a generic unbranded phone on a navy to logo-blue gradient; no footage, no presenter
skinAxes.transitions: hook as a push notification that opens into a card; cues push pages from the right; standard chapter transitions
skinAxes.texture: soft blurred brand shapes drifting, the phone floating, tap ripples, a shimmering loading feed between beats
skinAxes.sound: voice + a notification ding on the hook + cue clicks
skinAxes.cta: classic white contact card + compliance card
